items.modules: Which management modules are included in NeoERP?

items.multiCompany: How does NeoERP support businesses with multiple companies or branches?
items.access: Can I access NeoERP on computers and mobile devices?
items.sharedData: How can departments share data in NeoERP?
items.budget: Does NeoERP support budget management and forecasting?
items.finance: How does NeoERP support reporting and financial consolidation for multi-entity businesses?

answers.whatIs: NeoERP is an enterprise resource planning solution that integrates business functions from multiple departments into one software system. It can be used by businesses that need centralized management of business, operations, finance, and related processes.
answers.modules: The documented functional areas include sales, CRM, purchasing, warehouse, logistics, project management, HR and payroll, accounting and finance, budget and forecast, production, and maintenance.
answers.integration: NeoERP can connect with other systems through Webservice. The specific scope depends on the systems and integration requirements defined for each business.
answers.multiCompany: NeoERP supports centralized and consistent data management for multiple companies or branches, while enabling independent accounting by entity and consolidated financial reporting.
answers.access: NeoERP is web-based and can be accessed through computers and mobile devices.
answers.sharedData: Customer and business data can be managed centrally in one system. Integrated functions allow information to carry between processes, including connecting purchasing, sales, warehouse, production costing, and receipts and payments with accounting.
answers.budget: The Budget & Forecast module uses historical data to support budgeting and revenue forecasting.
answers.finance: Accounting & Finance aggregates accounting data and supports accounting, financial, and management reports. For multi-entity businesses, the system supports accounting by entity and consolidated financial reporting.
